reason: My register has never crashed on a Sunday with ten customers waiting. ₹999 a month is nothing for me, but if the app stops billing in the rush and nobody picks up the phone, I lose money and face in front of customers.
objection: Who will help me when something stops working on a busy Sunday? A training day at setup is fine, but I need to know a real person answers fast on weekends, or my stylists will go back to the register anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A written promise of same-day phone support on Sundays and holidays, plus seeing it running smoothly in another salon owner's shop near me for a few months.
